mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals increased demand in the housing sector, leading to positive economic sentiment and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative economic sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized, the combined effect signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.5pp and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the past 3 months, the combined effect signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp and PAYEMS increase > 200k in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals increased consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, the combined effect signals a contractionary supply shock with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: contractionary supply shock with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.
